options.name: alternate_lb_method
options.description: The load balancing mode the system tries if the C(preferred_lb_method) is unsuccessful in picking a pool.

options.name: availability_requirements
options.description: If you activate more than one health monitor, specifies the number of health monitors that must receive successful responses in order for the link to be considered available.

options.name: fallback_ip
options.description: Specifies the IPv4 or IPv6 address of the server to which the system directs requests when it cannot use one of its pools to do so. Note that the system uses the fallback IP only if you select the C(fallback_ip) load balancing method.

options.name: fallback_lb_method
options.description: The load balancing mode the system tries if both the C(preferred_lb_method) and C(alternate_lb_method)s are unsuccessful in picking a pool.

options.name: max_answers_returned
options.description: Specifies the maximum number of available virtual servers the system lists in a response. The maximum is 500.

options.name: members
options.description: Members to assign to the pool. The order of the members in this list is the order they will be listed in the pool.

options.name: monitors
options.description: Specifies the health monitors the system currently uses to monitor this resource. When C(availability_requirements.type) is C(require), you may only have a single monitor in the C(monitors) list.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: preferred_lb_method
options.description: The load balancing mode the system tries first.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: Pool state. When C(present), ensures the pool is created and enabled. When C(absent), ensures the pool is removed from the system. When C(enabled) or C(disabled), ensures the pool is enabled or disabled (respectively) on the remote device.

options.name: ttl
options.description: Specifies the number of seconds the IP address, once found, is valid.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of GTM pool you want to create.
